rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides SQL database connectivity for PostgreSQL, SQLite, and MySQL databases with read-only safety by default and optional write operations. Features comprehensive database introspection including table listing, schema description with foreign key relationships, sample data preview, query execution with automatic LIMIT injection, and query plan analysis. Implements robust security measures including SQL injection prevention, transaction-level read-only enforcement, query timeouts, and identifier sanitization.
